_comment: All coordinates verified against owner markups through 2026-08-06. Two coordinate systems: 'px' = pixel in source/Plot_Plan_Layout.png (2188x1137, north-up Google aerial, cropped exactly to parcel bbox); 'ft' = feet, origin SW corner of parcel bbox, +x east, +y north.

registration.note: Red overlay edges in the aerial run exactly along property lines (owner confirmed). ft_x = px_x * 0.26674; ft_y = 294.1 - px_y * 0.25889

parcel.legal: Parcel 1 of Parcel Map 05062 (owner doc: PM 69370)
parcel.gross_net_delta_explanation: Assessor net excludes road easements; the ~7,200 SF gross-net difference presumably reflects recorded easements — locations per PM 05062, TBD. No road crosses the parcel (owner 8/21/2026); the driveway exits between AG-9 and AG-12 to an access esmt. across the adjacent parcel.

barn.label: EXISTING BARN — STORAGE. 50' E-W x 44' N-S rectangle = 2,200 SF per owner (8/21/2026, second round), centred on the aerial trace centroid. NOT the Mini Barn Market. Not counted as ag.

storage_nw.label: EXISTING STORAGE 10'x10' = 100 SF (owner 8/21/2026 second round: storage ONLY, no sales — it is NOT the store).

store_mbm.label: PROPOSED 'MINI BARN MARKET' — SMALL AGRICULTURAL STORE, 12'x10' = 120 SF, UNDER CONSTRUCTION, just SW of the 10'x10' storage. LOCATION PER THE OWNER'S YELLOW-SQUARE MARKUP 8/22/2026 (an earlier placement W of the storage was wrong). Owner 8/21/2026: this new building is the store.

tiny_home_w.label: TINY HOME — TO BE REMOVED (owner). Not a shed. Drop from plan if removed before submittal.

greenhouse.label: AS-BUILT GREENHOUSE 12'x20' (240 SF; may qualify for ag bldg exemption — confirm with PDS. Sheet says AS-BUILT only, per owner 8/21/2026 — no 'unpermitted' tag)

utilities.leach_note: Owner 8/21/2026: leach lines must NOT cross under the garage. Rect moved E of the garage (garage E edge ~478.8 ft), inside the N property line. The wider px bbox is the aerial bed-patch trace, kept for reference.
utilities.electrical: 400A main panel adjacent NE of barn, ~(169.5, 173.6) ft, location approx.

roads._no_road_on_east: OWNER 8/21/2026 (fourth round): there is NO N-S road crossing the east portion — the old 'handlebar_rd'/'access_road_esmt' centerline trace was WRONG and is deleted. The driveway is the only travelled way; it exits between AG-9 and AG-12 near the SE corner and continues ±700' to Handlebar Rd via an access easement across the adjacent parcel. Never re-draw a road with edge lines on this parcel.

A spur runs S down the west yard toward the barn.
